newsitem.title: UK: Canadian Pizza confirms bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Pizza confirms bid approach.

text.p: British-based Canadian Pizza Plc confimed on Monday that it had received a tentative approach which may or may not lead to an offer for the company.
The company's share price was marked 13 pence higher at 102 1/2 p as Canadian Pizza confirmed a weekend press report that it was a possible takeover target.
The Sunday Telegraph newspaper said the manufacturer of pizza crusts, cooking sauces and fruit spreads was being considered as a target worth an estimated 20 million stg.
The paper said a bid had come from the Kent family which founded the company and still holds a 18 percent stake.
The report also mentioned an unknown overseas buyer as another potential suitor.
